prompt: Add a tRPC procedure called 'listByMonth' that returns all appointments for a given month and year.

assertions.description: Puts the procedure in src/configurations/trpc/router/calendarRouter.ts (not a new file, not router.ts)
Uses Prisma ORM (prisma.day.findMany or similar), not raw SQL or fetch
Uses Zod to validate the month and year inputs
Queries through the day model to get rdv records (correct schema relationship)
Does NOT require changes to router.ts (calendarRouter is already registered there)
